Good vehicular movement from Lekki Roundabout to Lekki Peninsula Gate, Fam City, Admiralty Roundabout, Roads 13 & 14, UBA Traffic Light, Zenith Junction, Dome/Freedom Way, and Itedo Car Wash, with traffic flowing freely.

Moderate traffic congestion from VFS to Ikate Gate due to traffic light automation at Ikate Roundabout.

Smooth return journey from Ikate Gate to VFS, Car Wash, Dome/Freedom Way, UBA/Admiralty Road Traffic Light, and Roads 13 & 14.

Busy traffic conditions on Admiralty Roundabout en route to Link Bridge due to evening rush hour.

Slow traffic movement on Alexandra inward Admiralty Roundabout due to speed breakers.

Free-flowing traffic from Farm City to Lekki Peninsula Gate and down to Lekki Roundabout.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Projects commissioning in the FCT
Day 11 - Thursday 26th June, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed Kugbo Bus Terminal.

We appeal to the motoring public to exercise patience, as traffic may be slightly slower to allow the passage of dignitaries en route to the Kugbo Bus Terminal for the commissioning ceremony.

Your cooperation is highly solicited as traffic personnel and security agents will be deployed to guide appropriately.

There will be no major diversion inbound and outbound of the venue.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
